name: Valeria Quispe
bio:
Valeria's journey in motorsport began unconventionally. While studying industrial engineering at the Universidad Nacional Mayor de San Marcos, she volunteered at a local karting track, quickly becoming indispensable due to her meticulous organizational skills and keen eye for detail. This led to an opportunity to assist a small rally team, where she managed logistics and pit stops. 

Her dedication and efficiency caught the attention of Oregon Team scouts. Valeria's approach to operations is data-driven, focusing on optimizing processes and resource allocation to maximize team performance. She is known for her ability to anticipate potential issues and implement proactive solutions, ensuring smooth operations even under pressure. What sets her apart is her unwavering commitment to fostering a collaborative and supportive team environment.

physical.hairStyle: long, wavy hair usually pulled back into a practical ponytail
physical.description: Valeria is of medium height with a focused and determined gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, even in digital meetings.
Has a specific type of Peruvian coffee she insists on having every morning.
Meticulously color-codes all her spreadsheets and documents.
